fato_historico: 1938: Kweilin incident: A Japanese warplane shoots down the Kweilin, a Chinese civilian airliner, killing 14. It is the first recorded instance of a civilian airliner being shot down.
energia_do_dia: Today, consider the fragility of flight and the profound value of every peaceful journey. While history reminds us of how precious our shared skies are, you may find your spirit soaring toward new horizons. It is a good time to protect your inner peace and focus on the freedom that fuels your adventurous Sagittarius heart.
frase_do_dia: Cherish the freedom to wander and the light that guides your journey home safely.
significado_numero: Represents the delicate balance between movement and finding your steady anchor.
conselho: Value your peaceful path today and treat every new horizon with gentle gratitude.
